title: AMD Just Pushed a $300 GPU to 4.8 GHz?! 🤯
description:
A $300 graphics card just hit 4.8 GHz. 🤯

AMD's graphics chief Jack Huynh and overclocker Bill Alverson pushed a Radeon RX 9060 XT to 4,837 MHz with liquid nitrogen at Micro Center's new Austin store — 48 MHz above the previous 4,789 MHz record and just 163 MHz shy of 5 GHz. AMD calls it a GPU frequency world record; there's no official body that ratifies these, so it's AMD's claim.

The catch: the RX 9060 XT you can buy boosts to up to 3,130 MHz (AMD spec). Launch prices: $299 (8 GB) and $349 (16 GB).

By our Spec or Wreck score: 61/100 → SPEC. Grab it if you want 16 GB of VRAM for $349.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
